Thanks Priya — great questions. Short answers below, and I’ve put links to the docs where helpful.

1) Data residency: yes — we can restrict processing to US regions for the pilot. We run hosted endpoints in us-west-2 and us-east-1 with tenant isolation; if you later need a Private deployment we can scope that in the SOW.

2) SSO / SAML (Okta): Redwood supports SAML-based SSO for the control plane. Marcus will cover a quick demo of the admin flows and how we provision service accounts during the pilot.

3) On-prem connector: yes — we offer a Private deployment option (VPC + on-prem package). For the pilot we usually start hosted (US-only) and validate latency/cost, then plan a migration path to Private if required.

Marcus — can you propose 2 slots the week of Sep 7 for a 45-minute technical walkthrough? I’ll prepare a sample latency-profile using a small anonymized dataset.
